matrix_name.name: cationic waterborne polyurethane with Diels-Alder bonds
matrix_name.description: CPA microspheres synthesized from IPDI, PTMG, MDEA, BDO, glycerol 1,2-carbonate, furfurylamine, and BMI; positively charged with quaternary ammonium ions; average particle size 1.5 um; Zeta potential +37.6 mV

fillers.name: carbon nanotube/graphene oxide hybrid
fillers.description: negatively charged CNTIGO hybrid; CNTs with average diameter 9.5 nm and average length 1.5 um; adsorbed on CPA microsphere surface via electrostatic attraction forming segregated conductive network
